name: sealed-eval corpus v3
purpose: Private sealed, out-of-sample evaluation of document chat (Aya), built independently of v1/v2 with non-overlapping topics (robotics and gravitational-wave physics papers, US energy and education statistics, Vietnamese higher-education and health regulations, dengue). Questions/answers are authored separately.
build: build_scripts/fetch.sh <slug> <url> <file> for each source (staging in /private/tmp/aya_v3_stage/<slug>/); then build_scripts/build_corpus.sh /private/tmp/aya_v3_stage raw/ ; then python3 -I build_scripts/make_manifest.py . (writes manifest.json and verifies every file)

files.description: Octo Model Team (Ghosh, Walke, Pertsch, Black, Mees et al.), 'Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy', arXiv v2 (May 2024). A transformer-based diffusion policy pretrained on 800k robot trajectories from the Open X-Embodiment dataset, released as Octo-Small (27M) and Octo-Base (93M). Contains architecture figures, zero-shot and finetuning success-rate figures, roman-numbered tables (e.g. TABLE V model variants on p15) and the diffusion denoising update as Eq. (1) on p5. Related to the OpenVLA paper (which re-evaluates Octo) and to the Octo GitHub README.

Kim, Pertsch, Karamcheti et al., 'OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model', CoRL 2024, arXiv v3. A 7B-parameter VLA (Llama 2 backbone with DINOv2+SigLIP vision encoders) trained on 970k Open X-Embodiment episodes; compares against RT-1-X (35M), RT-2-X (55B), Octo (93M) and Diffusion Policy, and studies LoRA/quantized fine-tuning. Numbered tables (Table 1 parameter-efficient fine-tuning p10, Table 2 memory/quantization p11, Table 3 data mixture p21, Tables 4-7 per-task results in the appendix) and many figures. Follow-up to Octo; its numbers about Octo come from its own evaluations.

files.description: LIGO Scientific Collaboration and Virgo Collaboration (Abbott et al.), 'Observation of Gravitational Waves from a Binary Black Hole Merger' (GW150914). Reports the first direct detection on 14 Sep 2015: primary/secondary masses 36 and 29 solar masses, final mass 62, 3.0 solar masses radiated, luminosity distance 410 Mpc, network SNR 24. Includes the chirp-mass formula (p3), Fig. 1 strain data, detector diagrams and Table I of source parameters (p7). Pairs with the GW151226 paper and with the Wikipedia list of observations (which carries later catalog values).

files.source_url: https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.04855 (PDF https://arxiv.org/pdf/1606.04855v1); published Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 241103 (2016)
files.description: LIGO/Virgo (Abbott et al.), 'GW151226: Observation of Gravitational Waves from a 22-Solar-Mass Binary Black Hole Coalescence'. Second confident detection (26 Dec 2015): initial masses 14.2 and 7.5 solar masses, final 20.8, chirp mass 8.9, 1.0 solar mass radiated, luminosity distance 440 Mpc, at least one spin > 0.2. Table I of source parameters on p4, figures of the whitened strain and posteriors, discussion of tests of general relativity and rate estimates. Direct follow-up to the GW150914 paper; same table layout with different values.

files.description: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO), October 2026 (60 pages). Forecasts through 2027 for oil, natural gas, electricity, coal, renewables and emissions, including a winter fuels outlook. Headline: Brent crude averages $96/b in 2026 and $84/b in 2027 (previous forecast $91 and $74), 4Q26 Brent $105/b; Henry Hub $3.48 (2026) and $3.16/MMBtu (2027). Narrative with charts on pp3-29; data tables (Table 1 U.S. energy markets summary onwards, Table 3a world liquids, etc.) on pp31-60. Next edition of the scanned September 2026 STEO.

Same structure as the October edition: narrative on pp3-29 with Brent forecast $91/b for 2026 and $74/b for 2027, natural gas storage outlook (3,969 Bcf on 31 Oct 2026) and electricity/coal/emissions sections; dense numeric tables (e.g. Table 3a world petroleum production and consumption on p33) on pp31-56. files.description: Slide deck by Angelina LaRose, EIA Deputy Administrator, 'EIA's Role in Supporting the Nation's Energy Dialogue', for the United States Association for Energy Economics, 4 March 2026 (13 slides, PowerPoint export; EIA's presentations page lists it as virtual, the title slide says Washington, DC). Covers EIA's users and web traffic (27.2 million visits in FY2024, ~1.1 million API requests/day), a table of its 67 energy surveys by category and frequency (slide 4), market-moving weekly reports, legal authority for data collection, and how the Short-Term Energy Outlook and Annual Energy Outlook are produced. Highlights of indicators on family characteristics, preprimary to postsecondary enrollment, finances, persistence, completions and outcomes, with numbered figures (FIGURE 1-23). Example: total undergraduate enrollment fell 13% from 17.7 million (fall 2012) to 15.4 million (fall 2022); ACGR 87% in 2021-22. Next edition of the scanned 2023 report; comparison windows shift by one year so overlapping indicators differ.

files.source_url: https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_gravitational_wave_observations&oldid=1380895898 (revision of 2026-10-18, via REST API page/html), converted to DOCX with python-docx
files.description: Wikipedia list of gravitational-wave events converted to DOCX with 4 large tables: confirmed events through O4 (189 rows x 17 columns: SNR, luminosity distance, energy radiated, chirp mass, effective spin, component and remnant masses and spins), marginal O1/O2 detections, O3 public-alert candidates and O4 candidates (176 rows). Text explains observing runs O1-O4 and naming. Catalog values differ from the original discovery papers (e.g. GW150914 distance 430 vs 410 Mpc, masses 35.6/30.6 vs 36/29; GW151226 masses 13.7/7.7 vs 14.2/7.5). Charts and references removed.

files.description: English Wikipedia article 'Dengue fever' (featured-quality medical article) as DOCX: signs and symptoms, cause and virology, mechanism, diagnosis and warning signs, prevention (vector control, Dengvaxia and Qdenga vaccines), management, epidemiology and history; infobox as a 2-column table. Burden figures: 390 million infections/year (2013 estimate), about 3.9 billion people at risk, WHO tenfold rise in recorded cases 2010-2019 (500,000 to 5 million), >5 million infections and >5,000 deaths reported in 2023. Cross-language pair with the Vietnamese article, whose figures are older and different.

files.description: Bài Wikipedia tiếng Việt 'Sóng hấp dẫn' dạng Markdown: định nghĩa theo thuyết tương đối rộng, dự đoán của Einstein (1916), bằng chứng gián tiếp từ hệ Hulse-Taylor, phát hiện trực tiếp của Advanced LIGO (sáp nhập hai lỗ đen 14/9/2015, công bố 11/2/2016), các hiệu ứng khi sóng truyền qua, ước lượng biên độ và tần số, nguồn phát (hệ sao đôi, sao xung/sao neutron, chế độ r). README of the Octo code repository at a pinned commit (2024-07-31): quick-start Python snippet loading octo-base-1.5 from Hugging Face, installation, examples, finetuning command, a table of checkpoints (Octo-Base 93M params at 13 it/sec, Octo-Small 27M at 17 it/sec, inference on 1x NVIDIA 4090), pretraining on 800k trajectories, codebase layout, FAQ and 'Updates for Version 1.5'. Companion to the Octo paper.

files.license: Public domain or CC0-1.0 (stated in the PEP)
files.description: PEP 703 'Making the Global Interpreter Lock Optional in CPython' (Sam Gross), reStructuredText source saved as plain text. Motivation from scientific computing and AI workloads, the --disable-gil build, biased and deferred reference counting, immortal objects, mimalloc-based allocation, per-object locking for containers, the specialization/caching changes, performance and compatibility discussion, rejected ideas and the Steering Council acceptance. Includes reST tables and code blocks.
